data.name: CanceledBeforeItRanMessage
data.value: The statement was canceled before it went to the database: nothing was run.

data.name: VaultChanged
data.value: The vault changed while the session was being opened.

data.name: NoTransactionLogManualCommit
data.value: This database has no transaction log: each statement is written when it finishes, and there is no Manual commit.

data.name: ResultNotFoundForCopy
data.value: The result no longer exists: the session ran another statement after it. Run the statement again to copy.

data.name: NoQueryToCount
data.value: No statement in this session returned rows to count.

data.name: TransactionOpenForAutoCommit
data.value: The tab has an open transaction: end it with Commit or Rollback before switching to Auto-commit.

data.name: TransactionOpenForIsolation
data.value: The tab has an open transaction: end it with Commit or Rollback before changing the isolation level.

data.name: NoOpenTransaction
data.value: There is no open transaction in this tab.

data.name: TransactionFailed
data.value: The transaction has an error: undo it with Rollback. Until then the database accepts no other statement in this tab.

data.name: SessionNotFound
data.value: The database session does not exist or has already been closed.

data.name: ResultNoLongerKept
data.value: The result is no longer kept in the session: another statement was run in it after it. Run the statement again to edit.

data.name: SchemaMayHaveChanged
data.value: A statement run after this result (such as a SET or a CALL) may have changed the session's current schema, and {0}, written without a schema, may be another table now. Nothing was written; write the schema in the statement (schema.table), or run it again.

data.name: ReadsAnotherTable
data.value: The statement now reads another table ({0}.{1}, and not {2}.{3}): the session's current schema changed since the query. Nothing was written; run the statement again.

data.name: TableChanged
data.value: The table {0} changed since the query (the key, the columns or their type). Nothing was written; run the statement again.

data.name: PlatformUnsupported
data.value: Prism for {0} does not connect to Db2 and Informix yet: IBM does not publish the driver for it.

data.name: CanceledBeforeItsTurn
data.value: The operation was canceled before its turn in the session came.

data.name: SessionBusy
data.value: The session is busy with another statement.

data.name: VariableSeveralStatementsMessage
data.value: A variable's query is a single statement, and the text has more than one; nothing was run.

data.name: VariableQueryNotRead
data.value: A variable's query must be a read: {0}.
